gloss: unlimited time plan; free time (as a service pricing option)

definitions.gloss: unlimited time plan; all-you-can-use time; free-time package
definitions.explanation: A pricing plan for time-based services under which a customer pays a set fee for unlimited or extended use within a given session — most commonly advertised at karaoke boxes, internet cafés, billiards halls, and manga cafés. Despite the English loan, this is a wasei-eigo term not used this way in English.

examples.japanese: フリータイム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I'll take the unlimited time plan, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧フリータイム⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2,500⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧です。
examples.english: The unlimited-time karaoke plan is 2,500 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧フリータイム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{利用|りよう}しています→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The unlimited-time plan is cheap on weekday afternoons, so I often use it with my friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネットカフェ→ネットカフェ：30266_nettokafe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧フリータイムなら、⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: With an internet café's free-time plan, the price is the same no matter how many hours you stay.

notes:
A Japanese-coined English expression (⟦{和製英語|わせいえいご}→和製英語：18947_waseieigo⟧) combining 'free' (as in 'free of restriction', not 'no cost') and 'time'. In English, the phrase 'free time' means leisure time, so this Japanese usage does not translate directly — a native speaker would say 'unlimited time plan' or 'all-you-can-use package'.

USAGE:
Most commonly seen on the menu boards of karaoke chains, internet/manga cafés (⟦ネットカフェ→ネットカフェ：30266_nettokafe⟧ / ⟦{漫画喫茶|まんがきっさ}→漫画喫茶：30265_mangakissa⟧), billiards halls, and similar time-rental businesses. The customer pays a flat fee for a long block of time (often several hours or until closing), in contrast with hourly pricing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フリータイム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter on the unlimited-time plan
- フリータイム⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: the unlimited-time rate
- ⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧フリータイム: weekday unlimited-time plan
- ⟦{土日|どにち}→土日：12082_donichi⟧フリータイム: weekend unlimited-time plan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時間制|じかんせい}: by-the-hour pricing — the opposite model, where the customer is charged per hour
- ⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: package rate — a set fee for a defined block of time (e.g., a 3-hour pack)
- ⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: extension fee — charged when staying past the end of a timed block
- ⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧: all-you-can-eat — parallel 'all-you-can-...' concept for food, using a native Japanese suffix
